top_signals.title: Copper Falls From Record as Mideast Tensions Weigh on Metals
top_signals.summary: Copper fell from a record and other industrial metals retreated as escalating hostilities in the Middle East underscored lingering headwinds, after a key gauge of London Metal Exchange prices surged to an all-time high.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: US Stocks Slip as $100 Brent Lifts Inflation Risk: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: US stock futures and Treasuries slipped in a market where inflation risks are the primary focus, with Brent crude topping $100 a barrel.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Apollo’s Kleinman Sees Golden Age of Capital as Corporates Spend
top_signals.summary: The private capital industry is in “a golden age of capital deployment” even as the era of cheap funds comes to an end, according to top Apollo Global Management Inc. executive Scott Kleinman.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
